About SolutionPrime Clean

We love cleanliness. We started by cleaning family homes, and we enjoyed the work so much that we stayed in this field.

Today SolutionPrime Clean is a team of cleaners serving Los Angeles and nearby areas. We treat every home the way we would treat a family home.

  • Attention to detailCorners, tracks, appliance fronts and the other spots a quick wipe skips.
  • A reliable teamOn time, polite and consistent, whether you are home or not.
  • Tailored to your homeWe clean the way your home needs, not from a fixed script.
  • Steady qualityEvery visit should feel as good as the first one.

Before you ask

What is the difference between regular and deep cleaning?

Regular cleaning keeps a home that is already in good shape fresh: surfaces, kitchen counters and sink, the outsides of appliances, cabinet fronts, bathrooms, mirrors, shower and tub, plus vacuuming and mopping. Deep cleaning goes further and adds baseboards, window sills, fixtures, corners and built-up grime. Doors are not part of either one, so ask us if you would like them done.

Do I have to start with a deep cleaning?

No. If your home has not been properly cleaned in a while, we suggest a deep cleaning first. If it is kept up, or was cleaned in the last month or two, start with a regular cleaning and add what needs attention, such as the inside of the oven, the fridge or windows. It is a recommendation, not a rule.

Do you clean inside the fridge and the oven?

Yes. Inside the fridge and inside the oven are $20 each, and you can add them in the price calculator above. Interior windows, inside kitchen cabinets, the balcony, baseboards, laundry and organizing are add-ons too.

When do you work, and can you clean today?

We work every day, around the clock. Tell us what time suits you and we will do our best to fit it. Same-day cleaning is often possible when a cleaner is free, so message us on WhatsApp and we will tell you right away.

How long does a cleaning take?

As a rough guide: a regular cleaning takes 2-3 hours for a home with up to 3 bedrooms and 3-6 hours for a larger one, a deep cleaning 3-5 hours (5-7 for larger homes), and a post-construction cleaning 4-7 hours. It depends on the size of the home, its condition and your add-ons, and we confirm the time when you book.

Will the price change after the cleaning?

No. The calculator gives you an estimate. Before we start, we confirm the final price with you by message or phone, and that is the price you pay. Nothing is added afterwards.

Is there a discount on the first cleaning?

Yes: 15% off your first cleaning and the add-ons you choose. Keep “This is my first cleaning” ticked in the calculator and your estimate already shows the lower price.

Is recurring cleaning cheaper?

Yes. From the second visit, recurring service costs less than a one-time clean: 15% off weekly, 10% off every two weeks and 5% off monthly. The discount applies to the cleaning itself, while add-ons keep their price. It stays in place as long as the schedule does. If visits stop, the next cleaning is priced as a one-time one.

Do I need to provide cleaning supplies?

No. We bring professional supplies and equipment. If you prefer certain products, or have allergies or delicate surfaces, tell us before the visit.

Do I need to be home, and how should I prepare?

You do not have to be home, but you are welcome to be. If you will not be there, send clear access instructions beforehand: gate or lockbox codes, parking and any pet notes. Before we arrive, pick up small items, clothes, toys and papers from floors, tables and beds so the time goes into cleaning. If the inside of cabinets, the fridge or the oven is in your order, empty them first.

Do you move furniture?

We do not move heavy furniture or appliances, for safety and to protect your floors. If you would like the area under a sofa or behind the fridge cleaned, please move it before we arrive.

Can I add services on the day?

Extras are arranged with us in advance rather than with the cleaner on the spot, so the plan and the price stay clear. Message us and we will add them to your booking.

Anything special for a move-out cleaning?

The home should be completely empty. Belongings left behind count as clutter and are not part of the cleaning, so please move them out first. If you need help clearing things, ask us and we will agree on it separately.

What if I am not happy with something?

Check the result when we finish and contact us within 24 hours with clear photos or video of the area. We will then offer one of three fixes: a cleaner comes back to redo that spot, a discount equal to the price of the missed item (for example, $20 off if the inside of the fridge was skipped), or a $50 credit toward your next cleaning. After 24 hours we still look at each case, but it is usually not possible to confirm the condition the home was left in.

What can cleaning not fix?

We clean without damaging your surfaces, so we avoid harsh acids and metal brushes on stone, glass and fixtures. Hard-water etching on shower glass, deep limescale, and scratches or chemical marks left by earlier cleaning may not come off in one visit, and some only fade over a few. If we have worked on an area with professional products and real effort, it counts as done.

What is your cancellation policy?

You can cancel or reschedule free of charge up to 24 hours before your appointment. Within 24 hours, a late-cancellation fee applies: $40 per scheduled cleaner ($80 for a team of two, $120 for a team of three), because that time was held for your home.

Which areas do you serve?

We mostly work in Downtown Los Angeles and within about 22 miles (35 km) around it. If you are further out, message us: we can often arrange to come to your area and will check availability for your district. You can also check your ZIP code in the service-area section above.
